name: Mediterranean Ground Beef and Cabbage Skillet

fit.note: 419 cal / 22g carbs clears 400-650 cal and <=35g carb; ground beef + shredded cabbage/carrots, no rice/pasta/potato/bread; big skillet weigh-and-divide scales to 14. baharat unmapped is wanted for the pricer lane, not penalised.

dupe_evidence: Not a dupe of the catalog's ground-beef+cabbage dish: unstuffed-cabbage-roll-bowls is a crushed-tomato + rice cabbage-roll bowl (tomato sauce base, rice starch, Eastern-European), while this is a no-tomato, no-rice Middle Eastern skillet spiced with baharat/cumin/coriander, finished with vinegar and carrots - only protein+cabbage+skillet-method overlap (2 of 4); sauce/flavor family and starch both differ. The sourcer-flagged 'beef-unstuffed-cabbage-skillet' does not exist in the digest.
cross_protein_flags: Structurally the same dinner as a ground-turkey-and-cabbage skillet or ground-lamb-and-cabbage skillet with the same Middle Eastern (baharat/cumin/coriander) spicing - decider should check the turkey and lamb pools for a same-dish-different-protein twin.
